content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the `-a` option in the `udevadm info` command incorrectly enumerating environment variables instead of the expected sysfs attributes of a device. This issue was introduced by a previous commit that changed the enumeration logic from using device properties to using an inappropriate set of attributes, which did not align with the intended functionality of the command. The patch rectifies this by replacing the enumeration of device properties with the correct enumeration of sysfs attributes, ensuring that the tool behaves as expected.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the `-a` option in the `udevadm info` command incorrectly enumerating environment variables instead of the expected sysfs attributes of a device. This issue was introduced by a previous commit that changed the enumeration logic from using device properties to using an inappropriate set of attributes, which did not align with the intended functionality of the command. The patch rectifies this by replacing the enumeration of device properties with the correct enumeration of sysfs attributes, ensuring that the tool behaves as expected.
Patch:
From 6d6308f6774b4c684de7f3aab12cb752c59d5e2f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Mantas=20Mikul=C4=97nas?= <grawity@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Feb 2019 06:30:49 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] udevadm info: "-a" should enumerate sysfs attributes, not
 envs (#11642)

This fixes a bug introduced by 13aca847695f49afeb93367ecdad76035fa6c139.
---
 src/udev/udevadm-info.c | 5 ++++-
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/udev/udevadm-info.c b/src/udev/udevadm-info.c
index 135a5e0120..ebd15d384a 100644
--- a/src/udev/udevadm-info.c
+++ b/src/udev/udevadm-info.c
@@ -61,12 +61,15 @@ static bool skip_attribute(const char *name) {
 static void print_all_attributes(sd_device *device, const char *key) {
         const char *name, *value;
 
-        FOREACH_DEVICE_PROPERTY(device, name, value) {
+        FOREACH_DEVICE_SYSATTR(device, name) {
                 size_t len;
 
                 if (skip_attribute(name))
                         continue;
 
+                if (sd_device_get_sysattr_value(device, name, &value) < 0)
+                        continue;
+
                 /* skip any values that look like a path */
                 if (value[0] == '/')
                         continue;
